summary: Join our ISO training to learn about international safety standards and compliance. Boost your career and ensure your organization meets essential regulations.
lede: International safety standards training helps safety, operations, project and compliance professionals apply safety management principles in their work. It covers identifying workplace hazards, assessing risks and selecting controls, alongside interpreting ISO 45001 requirements and maintaining practical safety records. Participants also learn to investigate incidents, plan internal audits and track corrective actions to support ongoing improvement.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly make decisions that affect safety, risk, and compliance:
modules: Foundations of International Safety Standards and ISO
ISO Management System Approach and Safety Governance
Hazard Identification and Risk Assessment in Practice
Legal, Regulatory, and Client Compliance in Safety
Safety Procedures, Documentation, and Records Management
Safety Culture, Leadership, and Worker Engagement
Incident Reporting, Investigation, and Corrective Action
Internal Safety Audits and Continuous Improvement (ISO 19011)
Implementing and Integrating a Safety Management System
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of workplace safety principles and some experience in a safety-related role. Familiarity with ISO standards is helpful but not required.
